question:
How many dresses are trousers? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abd371765e597b074e99b76c6f325e91525c7d9f5dec7a3ff43ad60266bf9199.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92983fccdbd53364c39db3782109696154b7a436ce73278ef26bac2598d7ba21.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of dresses are trousers".

So, the total number of dresses are trousers = 3 + 4 = 7.

Hence, the correct answer is "7".
